extras: Requires an active paid Nori account; no telemetry or ads; device token stored locally.
intentEvidence: Sync your Obsidian vault with your Nori account — a study platform for medical students.
problem: It addresses the need to keep study notes and associated files synchronized between the Obsidian vault and the Nori study platform.
summary: Nori Sync synchronizes an Obsidian vault with a Nori study account using a one-time linking code, managing files and images between the two platforms.
